content: भोस् {%ind.%} A vocative particle used in addressing persons, and translatable by ‘o’, ‘sir’, ‘oh’, ‘halloo’, {sic} ‘ah’; (it drops its final {%visarga%} before vowels and soft consonants); कः कोऽत्र भोः <ls>Ś. 2</ls>; अयि भो महर्षिपुत्र <ls>Ś. 7</ls>; it is sometimes repeated; भो भोः शंकरगृहाधिवासिनो जानपदाः <ls>Māl. 3</ls>; भो भोः पण्डिताः श्रूयताम् <ls>H.</ls> भोस् is said to have, in addition, the senses of ‘sorrow’ and ‘interrogation’.
